glossary.definition: (1) "Lottery prize award" includes a prize award from a video lottery terminal but does not include winnings from lottery sports gaming, except for winnings from lottery sports gaming wagers placed through a terminal described in division (B)(3) of section 3770.24 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 3123.89 - Intercept directive issued to lottery commission where winner in default.

glossary.definition: (2) "Lottery sports gaming" has the same meaning as in section 3770.23 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 3123.89 - Intercept directive issued to lottery commission where winner in default.

glossary.definition:
(3) "Video lottery terminal" has the same meaning as in section 3770.21 of the Revised Code.
